meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow: the user themselves saying ulw-plan, ulw plan, /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in their own words for a work plan before coding. NEVER self-activates: a bare ulw/ultrawork run, an agent-side routing decision, or reading this file is not a request, and the plan-gated reviewers (metis/momus) stay locked without a user request plus a written .omo/plans plan file. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, ulw plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 动工前把需求与取舍谈清楚,产出一份可直接执行的工作计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果写代码前想先把范围、取舍和步骤谈清楚再动手
copy.tagline_en: Talk requirements and tradeoffs through, then produce one executable work plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want scope and tradeoffs settled before writing code

howto.what: Claude 会切换成规划顾问 Prometheus:先只读地探索代码库、做调研,只问少数关键取舍,等你明确同意后写出唯一一份决策完整的工作计划;它自己不写任何产品代码。
howto.when: 只在你本人主动要求规划工作流时启用,例如你说 “ulw-plan”、“ulw plan”,或用自己的话提出“先做个计划再动手”等;单独跑 ulw 或由代理自行决定都不会触发。

say.text: ulw-plan:给登录接口加每 IP 每分钟 5 次的限流
say.note: 它会先探索、再问关键取舍,等你点头才写计划

say.text: 帮我先规划一下,再动手改支付流程
say.note: 它不会直接改代码,只输出计划

say.text: /skill:ulw-plan 高精度,这块要做深度评审
say.note: 交接前会跑 momus 与 Codex 两路评审

howto.what_en: Claude switches to Prometheus, a planning consultant: it explores the codebase read-only, researches, asks only the key forks, and after your explicit okay writes one decision-complete work plan. It never edits product code.
howto.when_en: Only when you yourself ask for planning, e.g. you say "ulw-plan" or "/skill:ulw-plan", or ask for a plan before coding. A bare ulw run or an agent-side routing decision never triggers it.

say_en.text: ulw-plan: add a 5/min-per-IP rate limit to /login
say_en.note: It explores, asks the key forks, then writes the plan after your okay

say_en.text: Plan this first before touching the payment flow
say_en.note: It won't edit code; it only writes a plan

say_en.text: /skill:ulw-plan with high accuracy - do a deep review
say_en.note: Runs momus plus Codex review before handoff
